description: This file defines CSS mixins related to images, including responsive images and retina displays. It provides reusable styles for scaling images and handling high-DPI screens within the Bootstrap framework.

methods.name: img-responsive
methods.description: Mixin to keep images from scaling beyond their parent width, supporting responsive design.

methods.name: img-retina
methods.description: Mixin to set appropriate background images for retina displays, with media queries for high pixel density devices.
